title: Circuit Condensation: Post-Training that Concentrates a Behavior's Causal Circuit
abstract: arXiv:2608.27254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One approach to mechanistic interpretability explains behavior through circuits: the components and connections that carry it. Frozen discovery often returns hundreds of edges, making them hard to inspect, compare, or verify exhaustively. We introduce Circuit Condensation, which post-trains models to concentrate behaviors into smaller causal graphs. Each round prunes low-attribution edges and trains a low-rank adapter to match the original through what remains, retaining the cut only if task performance and general capability survive. Across four behaviors and eight models, condensed circuits are smaller than the strongest frozen baseline in 30 of 32 settings, by $8.1\times$ on average and up to $316\times$. Repeating the search without weight updates produces larger circuits in 29 of 32 settings, showing that weight updates, rather than search alone, drive the reduction. Testing every subset of 19 circuits finds 11 that cannot be reduce

translated_title: 电路浓缩：训练后聚焦行为因果电路的方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27254v1 公告类型：新 摘要：机械可解释性的一种方法通过电路来解释行为：即承载行为的组件和连接。冻结发现通常返回数百条边，使其难以全面检查、比较或验证。我们引入了电路浓缩，这是一种训练后方法，将行为集中到更小的因果图中。每一轮修剪低归因边，并训练一个低秩适配器，通过剩余部分匹配原始行为，仅当任务性能和通用能力保持时保留裁剪。在四种行为和八个模型上，浓缩电路在32个设置中的30个中比最强的冻结基线更小，平均缩小8.1倍，最大达316倍。在无权重更新的情况下重复搜索，在32个设置中的29个产生更大的电路，表明权重更新而非单纯搜索驱动了缩减。测试19个电路的每个子集发现11个无法进一步缩减。
tldr: 本文提出电路浓缩方法，通过训练后权重更新与边修剪，将行为因果电路显著缩小至最小，平均缩小8.1倍，并证明权重更新是缩减的关键。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Circuit Condensation, a post-training method that concentrates behavioral causal circuits via weight updates and edge pruning, achieving up to 316x reduction and showing weight updates are essential.
